A new type of battles fought alongside combinations of 100 and more heroes. There are 100 and more heroes for players to ally with, allowing them to combine the unique traits of multiple heroes and create their own powerful parties who will help them fight their way through the dead souls of Hell.

A new form of “WARRIORS” where heroes can be summoned to help eliminate enemies. By summoning heroes, the player can engage in impressive battles where they daringly rout endless hordes of enemies. This feature will offer players a new form of exhilaration never before experienced in the “WARRIORS” series.
